Team project | Four contributors

Burzarsnet

The problem

South African applicants need a way to find bursary and internship opportunities, while administrators need to manage the information published.

My contribution

I collaborated with three other contributors to develop the bursary and internship website. This was a shared team delivery.

Technologies and approach

Web application development, administrative content management and team collaboration.

What it delivers

The team developed a platform for bursary and internship listings with administration capabilities.

Current status

My contribution is presented as part of a four-person team, without attributing the entire implementation to me.
